caption: The video captures a wide, elevated view of a forested mountain valley beneath a flat, overcast white sky. A dense stand of dark conifers mixed with bare deciduous trees fills the foreground, while a snow-dusted ridge sits in the background with both ends cut off by the frame. The main moving element is a band of low-lying grey-white fog drifting slowly through the mid-ground valley. Its wisps and puffs deform and shift position over time, swirling gently above the treetops rather than holding still. On the right-hand slope the hazy layer appears to thicken over the bare branches. The conifer canopy and the snow-dusted ridge keep essentially the same shape and position throughout, with no noticeable wind sway. The mountains and foreground trees largely stay aligned with the image edges, consistent with a static camera.
relations: Low-lying fog in the mid-ground valley drifts slowly, its wisps deforming and shifting position over time.
On the right-hand slope, the hazy fog layer appears to thicken over the bare deciduous branches.
The foreground conifer canopy and background snow-dusted ridge maintain their shape and position without wind sway.
The static camera keeps the mountains and foreground trees aligned with the image edges throughout.
